lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho12Ga4C4 (Ho3GaC) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers coordinated by six Ho neighbors, while Ga centers have 13 neighbors (4 C, 9 Ho) and Ho centers have 14 neighbors (2 C, 6 Ga, 6 Ho). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ho-centered 14-vertex polyhedra, and corner sharing between Ho and Ga polyhedra.
